titulo: Getaway Files #15: how he lost the cops in GTA 6 #shorts
texto:
Rule one of losing the cops: break line of sight. He leaves the road, cuts through the brush, stays in the tall grass and takes the ugly exit through a tree and a fence. Part two of the sunset shortcut chase. Would you have stayed on the road?
